description: Validate an Argentine tax ID (CUIT/CUIL): checks length, prefix and modulo-11 check digit offline, and returns normalized and formatted values plus entity type (person/company). Send {cuit}. Nothing is stored. Paid tool: 0.01 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

cuit.description: CUIT or CUIL, with or without dashes

name: ar_cuit
title: Validate Argentine CUIT/CUIL
